palette.name: Pepto PAL
palette.note: Pepto/colodore PAL measurement, the same 16 RGB triples tools/assets.py renders the sheets with.

regions.note: cleared on every room load and never written again; every inline string and every print_message call site targets rows 21-24.  Only the shipped room editor uses this row.

regions.font: text font while text_font_panel is set, else room charset
regions.color: set per screen, 1 (white) everywhere in the shipped game

raster_split.note: Three splits per frame re-point the character generator. Raster lines are C64 raster numbers; text row r occupies rasters 51+8r .. 58+8r.

steps.font: text font if text_font_panel else room charset

raster_split.effect: rows 0-19 always use the room charset; row 20 always uses the text font; rows 21-24 use whichever the text_font_panel flag selects ($0A4B: 4 = text font, 2 = room charset).

sprites.priority: all sprites draw in front of the characters

placement.note: Both the player and a creature are one 24x42 figure made of two stacked hardware sprites, positioned from a whole cell.
placement.feet_row_boundary: the last pixel row of the figure is the first pixel row of row + 1

frame_rate.note: The game shipped for NTSC; every duration in this spec is a frame count, and seconds assume NTSC.

text_encoding.inline_string: two-byte little-endian screen address, then ASCII bytes; the first byte with bit 7 set ends the string and is not drawn
text_encoding.message_table: same, without the address; strings are concatenated and each is terminated by a byte with bit 7 set

frame_roles.role: hollow box; sprite 7, the kiniport and room-editor pointer, colour 7

facing.right: horizontal mirror of the same frame, built at run time by reversing the bits of each row and swapping the row's first and third byte

walk_cycle.note: the creature walk cycle is frame 0, 1, 0, 2, 0, 1, ... ; the column advances on the even phase only

player_animations.note: Every player sheet has the same 24 frames.  A step lasts `ticks` video frames and then the next step runs; dx/dy is the cell movement that happens on that step.
player_animations.src: $9DF6 stand, $A41D walk, $A4A8 climb, $A39A glide, $A21C leap, $A2FB knock-down

run.note: same frames as walk, periods 3 and 2

climb.note: dy is -1 going up, +1 going down

fall.note: falling never changes the sprite; whatever frame was showing stays up for the whole fall

leap.note: one launch step, then 4-6 flight steps; dx is always one column in the facing direction, dy comes from the arc in docs/spec/player.md

stoop.note: one-shot pose entering or leaving a crawl

knocked_down.note: 11 steps of 15 ticks: 9 alternating stars frames, then the stoop pose, then back to idle

lying_down.note: asleep in a nid, or carried home

screens.render: room 157 in the playfield, main-menu text in the panel

playfield.note: the "BELOW THE ROOT / STORY BY ZILPHA KEATLEY SNYDER" lettering is room tiles, drawn from the sign range $80-$99 of the room charset

screens.render: room 157 in the playfield, character text in the panel
screens.preview_caveat: rows 20-24 of that PNG use stale colour bytes; the real panel is colour 1

screens.render: the decoded room in the playfield; message line and panel blank
four rows of verb names over the panel

panel.highlight: set bit 7 of every code in the selected cell

screens.render: text written into the message line and/or the panel over whatever room is showing
room 157 or 228 with a scripted player, plus four inline text pages in the panel

other.what: the initial object table, copied wholesale to $0D00-$0FFF when a quest starts

fields.meaning: bits 0-4 screen row, bit 5 carried, bit 6 exists, bit 7 room number high bit

other.not_graphics: the PNGs assets/tooltab_chars.png and assets/tooltab_sprites.png are the discarded graphics readings; they are noise

other.what: which room and rule emits each message
the two attract-mode joystick scripts; see docs/spec/time.md
